sources.name: nazario-2025.mbox
sources.labels: Author hand-classified phishing; original labels retained

audit.selection: All eligible non-archive labelled-source mail; bulk archives fill remaining slots by fixed content hash; global hash order; no model scores used
audit.caveat: Historical public mail unused in development and prior benchmarks before this experiment, not customer traffic. The ready 25971-message labelled-source preview is included again with the same unchanged models, so it is not another independent test. GenSpam is anonymized; published ASCII mail has removed headers; Nazario is a single manually labelled inbox. Bulk spam traps are weak spam labels and come from a previously used provider in different years. Exact fingerprints and campaign prefixes exclude known relatives, but semantic near-duplicates may remain. HAM sample size may not establish extremely rare production FP. No synthetic messages or duplicated refill are used.
